certificates.description: Certificates to serve a hostname with, keyed by hostname, valued by the path to the certificate on the machine.

deployKey.description: Path to the public key the ocel-deploy login accepts; defaults to the bootstrapping login's keys.

proxy.description: What fronts this machine on ports 80 and 443. Leave it out and ocel runs its own proxy; name the one the machine already runs to deploy behind it.

traefik.description: A Traefik the machine already runs, reading ocel's routes from a directory its file provider watches.

directory.description: The directory Traefik's file provider watches, where ocel writes its routers.

entrypoints.description: The entry points ocel's routers attach to.

http.description: The entry point ocel's http-to-https redirect routers attach to; web when left out.

https.description: The entry point ocel's hostname routers attach to; websecure when left out.

entrypoints.title: Entrypoints

network.description: A docker network ocel's switchboard joins, so Traefik reaches it by name. Not with port.

port.description: The loopback port ocel's switchboard is published on for Traefik to reach; 8480 when left out. Not with network.

preset.description: The host tool whose Traefik this is. It fills in every other field, and a field written beside it overrides.

previewResolver.description: A resolver that can issue the preview base's wildcard over DNS-01. Set, previews share one wildcard certificate; left out, each preview hostname gets its own from resolver.

resolver.description: The certificate resolver every hostname router ocel writes names.

directory.description: The directory Traefik's file provider watches, where ocel writes its routers.

entrypoints.description: The entry points ocel's routers attach to.

http.description: The entry point ocel's http-to-https redirect routers attach to; web when left out.

https.description: The entry point ocel's hostname routers attach to; websecure when left out.

entrypoints.title: Entrypoints

network.description: A docker network ocel's switchboard joins, so Traefik reaches it by name. Not with port.

port.description: The loopback port ocel's switchboard is published on for Traefik to reach; 8480 when left out. Not with network.

previewResolver.description: A resolver that can issue the preview base's wildcard over DNS-01. Set, previews share one wildcard certificate; left out, each preview hostname gets its own from resolver.

resolver.description: The certificate resolver every hostname router ocel writes names.

traefik.title: Traefik

caddy.description: A Caddy the machine already runs, importing ocel's site blocks from a directory.

config.description: The config file caddy reload names inside the container; /etc/caddy/Caddyfile when left out.

container.description: The container Caddy runs in; left out, Caddy runs as the systemd caddy.service.

directory.description: The directory the running Caddy imports site blocks from.

network.description: A docker network ocel's switchboard joins, so Caddy reaches it by name. Not with port.

port.description: The loopback port ocel's switchboard is published on for Caddy to reach; 8480 when left out. Not with network.

preset.description: The host tool whose Caddy this is. It fills in every other field, and a field written beside it overrides.

config.description: The config file caddy reload names inside the container; /etc/caddy/Caddyfile when left out.

container.description: The container Caddy runs in; left out, Caddy runs as the systemd caddy.service.

directory.description: The directory the running Caddy imports site blocks from.

network.description: A docker network ocel's switchboard joins, so Caddy reaches it by name. Not with port.

port.description: The loopback port ocel's switchboard is published on for Caddy to reach; 8480 when left out. Not with network.

caddy.title: Caddy

manual.description: A proxy you route to ocel yourself; ocel writes nothing to it.

network.description: A docker network ocel's switchboard also joins, so a proxy on it reaches the switchboard by name even after it is recreated.

port.description: The loopback port your proxy forwards to ocel's switchboard on; 8480 when left out.

manual.title: Manual

proxy.title: Proxy

ssh.description: The machine to deploy onto: a Host alias from ssh_config, or the destination spelled out.

host.description: The hostname or address to reach the machine at.

identityFile.description: The private key to authenticate with, as a path.

port.description: The port sshd listens on. Omit it and ssh's own default stands.

user.description: The account to log in as. Omit it and ssh resolves the user itself.
